How much of the liquid (mL) does Steffi squirt into each kitten's mouth?

How much of the antibiotic (mg) does the cat need? How much of the liquid (mL) does Steffi need to hide in the cat's tuna meal?
p7_cat_banksy_convenia.brd: Banksy the cat was diagnosed with a urinary tract infection. The vet decided that the injectable antibiotic Convenia was the best choice. How much of the antibiotic (mg) did Banksy need? And how much of the liquid solution (mL) did the veterinarian draw up?
